welcome:
👋 Welcome to {brand}!

🛍 Marketplace · 👛 Wallet · 🎯 Quests · 🤝 Referrals · 🤖 AI assistant

Tap a button below or just type anything to talk to my AI brain.
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
panic_mode: 🚨 Maintenance mode is ON. Only the owner can use the bot right now.
not_whitelisted: ⛔ You are not whitelisted yet. Ask the owner for access.
rate_limited: ⏳ Slow down! Please wait {seconds}s and try again.
help_body:
/market — browse the marketplace
/wallet — balance, top-up, transfers
/orders — my purchases & deliveries
/quests — daily quests & rewards
/leaderboard — top users
/referral — invite & earn
/book — book a meeting
/lang — change language
/support — talk to support agent

Or just chat with me — I'm powered by 6 AI agents!
market_empty: 📦 No products yet — be the first seller! (Owner can add via /owner)
market_search_hint: 🔎 Send a keyword to search, or /market for all products.
purchase_pending_stars: 🧾 Invoice sent — pay with ⭐ Stars to complete your order.
insufficient_funds:
💸 Not enough credits. Balance: {balance}, needed: {needed}.
Top up via 👛 Wallet.
no_orders: No orders yet — time to grab something from /market!
review_prompt: ⭐ How would you rate this product? Send 1-5.
topup_stars_hint: Send the number of ⭐ Stars to convert (e.g. 100). Rate: 1 ⭐ = {rate} credits.
withdraw_requested: 📝 Withdrawal request submitted — waiting for owner approval (HITL).
ai_placeholder: Just type anything — my AI agents are listening!
ai_disabled: 🤖 AI key not configured — running in smart-rules mode. Ask the owner to set AI_API_KEY.
booking_none: No upcoming bookings. /book to schedule one.
broadcast_hint: 📣 Send the message to broadcast. It will be queued for YOUR approval first (HITL).
kill_switch_on: 🚨 PANIC MODE ON — bot locked for everyone except staff.
welcome_bonus: 🎁 Welcome! +{credits} credits added to your wallet.
withdraw_prompt: 🎫 Send the amount in credits to withdraw (number):
deliver_prompt: 🚚 Send the delivery content (link / text / file_id) for this order — or /skip:
deliver_done: ✅ Order delivered — the buyer has been notified.
deliver_skip_hint: ⚠️ Delivered without payload. Remember to send the content to the buyer directly.
sales_empty: No sales yet. Share your store and let /market do the rest!
refund_requested: ↩️ Refund request sent — the owner will review it (HITL).
notify_order_cancelled:
❌ Your order was cancelled — payment was not completed in time.
🛒 {title}
product_wizard_price_credits: 💎 Price in CREDITS (your users' currency). Stars are computed automatically:
purchase_confirm_title:
🛒 Confirm purchase

📦 {title}
💎 {credits} credits (your balance: {balance})

This action is irreversible — delivery items cannot be undone.
payment_order_unavailable: ⚠️ This order is no longer payable (expired or cancelled) — the invoice was not accepted. Please start again from /market.
payment_order_gone_refunded: ⚠️ The order was no longer payable — your Stars payment has been refunded automatically. Sorry for the friction! Start again from /market.
payment_order_gone_contact_support: ⚠️ There was a problem completing your purchase. Your payment is safe — the owner has been notified and will resolve it (or refund it) shortly.
notify_refund_approved_stars:
↩️ Refund approved: +{credits} credits (ref {ref}).
ℹ️ You paid {stars}⭐ — per marketplace policy, Stars payments are refunded in credits at the frozen purchase rate.
notify_referral_joined: 🤝 New referral joined with your link! +{credits} credits
notify_referral_first_purchase: 💰 Your referral made their first purchase — bonus +{credits} credits!
kill_confirm:
🚨 Confirm: activate KILL SWITCH?
